analysis_summary: This ontology models the public opinion ecosystem in Brazil surrounding the arrival and evaluation of text-to-video generative AI models (such as those referenced in the Magicboard documentation). The framework centers on the tension between ordinary citizens vulnerable to hyper-realistic deepfakes or scams, local content creators adopting automated tools, investigative journalists and fact-checkers, regulators enforcing safety, and tech companies developing generative systems with immature safety filters.
